story.fullStory:
The Doobie Brothers's "Listen To The Music" reached #11 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Listen to the Music" is a song by American rock band the Doobie Brothers, released on their second album, Toulouse Street (1972).

The song was written by Tom Johnston and was the band’s first major hit.

In 1994, it received a remix by Steve Rodway a.k.a.

The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

facts.text: "Listen to the Music" is a song by American rock band the Doobie Brothers, released on their second album, Toulouse Street (1972).
The song was written by Tom Johnston and was the band’s first major hit.
In 1994, it received a remix by Steve Rodway a.k.a.
The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.
Toulouse Street is the second studio album by American rock band the Doobie Brothers.
It was released in July 1972, by Warner Bros.
It was the band's first album with bassist Tiran Porter and also the first with drummer Michael Hossack to augment existing drummer John Hartman, putting in place their trademark twin-drummer sound.
